resources.string: One alert each morning, when the new issue is out.
The app can let you know each morning at 7:00 a.m. CET/CEST when the new issue is out. No data is sent: your phone only checks the paper\'s website to see whether it is out.
Alerts are on: each morning at 7:00 a.m. CET/CEST, you get a notification with the day\'s issue.
Without permission to show notifications, the app cannot alert you. You can allow it in Android settings.
